page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m2.large is a burstable virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, and is paired with 4.0 GB of system memory. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tier of cloud resources. The CPU performance, measured via stress-ng, yields a single-core score of 1087.69 and a multi-core score of 2161.79, indicating limited processing capacity. Memory bandwidth is similarly constrained, with uncached read speeds at 16.56 GB/sec and write speeds at 14.15 GB/sec. Geekbench testing results in a single-core score of 891.0 and a multi-core score of 1562.0, reflecting its entry-level computational capabilities.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation model, the instance is designed for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that experience occasional spikes. It is qualitatively highly cost-efficient for non-production environments, development staging, lightweight microservices, and low-traffic static web serving, where continuous high-performance compute is not required.
